name: web-botanical-supplement-formats-reviews-and-meadow-footer
title: Supplement page sections: four format cards, giant caps testimonial heading and a meadow footer
whatItIs: A white rounded page on grey with sections for product formats (capsules, gummies, liquid drops, lozenges as tall tiles alternating grey and pale lime with 3D renders), a giant uppercase heading with green highlighted words, a review row (rating card, video testimonial, quote with stats), and a footer over a misty meadow with an email signup.
whatItMeans: Clean, fresh and natural; lime tiles and uppercase light type feel modern-wellness.
techniques: Alternate grey and pale lime tall tiles for choices.
Highlight alternate words of a giant uppercase heading in green.
Mix rating, video and quote cards in one row.
End with a photo footer and single email field.

vocabulary.definition: A tall card showing one product form.
Alternating words coloured in a heading.
Rating, video and quote cards together.
A footer built on a photograph.
